critical_code_review_comments: Zero-knowledge Health Drop pipeline correctly enforces server-side ciphertext-only ingestion at routes/health.py:652 — server never receives plaintext; encryption happens in provider's browser via tweetnacl (frontend/src/dropcrypto.ts). GID verification at line 671 accepts full DID OR last-6-chars short GID via `gid == did or gid == did[-6:]` — good UX + security balance. Empty file (400) + >15MB file (400) + missing pubkey (409) all guarded.

Auto-Booker at routes/hunter.py:341 creates BOTH waitlist row (status=booked) AND calendar_events row in one atomic flow (though not in a Mongo transaction — could race if paired with a mid-flight delete, but low practical risk). Deterministic slot simulation via SHA-256(specialty|city) ensures repeatable UX for demos. Simulated flag returned in every response — honest UX.

Calendar timeline at routes/health.py:757 uses 90-day booster horizon (line 765) — matches spec 'booster_due within 60 days' test with generous headroom. Events correctly sorted DESC by ISO date (string sort is safe for YYYY-MM-DD format). upcoming_exams filters category=='exam' AND date>=today; booster_alerts filters category=='vaccine' AND booster_due<=horizon — clean predicates.

Mental Fortress + Physio-AI content externalized to backend/content.py (105 lines, 4 languages × 6 techniques × 6 languages × 3 guides). tts_text is generated server-side by joining steps with locale-aware 'Step/Krok/Schritt' prefix at routes/health.py:602 — no client-side i18n needed.

PUBLIC portal /drop/[dropId] correctly gated: only info + upload accept anonymous requests, but upload requires GID match. No user_id enumeration possible via /info (only first-name hint returned). Storage path uses APP_NAME/drops/{user_id}/{drop_doc_id}.bin — properly isolated per-user.
